types.description: C60N miniature circuit breaker / 2 poles / 6 A / curve C

document.title: Schneider Electric Multi 9 — Sistema apparecchiature modulari
document.pages: Printed 15: 2P 6 A curve C selection row and E45094 diagram; printed 14: ratings

modelingNotes: Exact catalog p.15, 2P block, 6 A row, curve C column identifies 24267. Four 9 mm modules (36 mm).

Catalog p.15 diagram E45094 explicitly numbers two mechanically ganged protected poles 1–2 and 3–4. Numeric keys preserve markings; no phase or neutral assignment is inferred. Open contact state follows the diagram, not an assertion about installed handle position.
6 A nominal current at 30 °C; curve C magnetic trip 5–10 In. Current fields describe the breaker rating, not conductor sizing or fault-current capability.

Catalog p.14: Ue 400 V AC; CEI EN 60898 Icn 6000 A at 400 V for 2P; CEI EN 60947-2 Icu 20 kA at 230–240 V and 10 kA at 400–415 V for 2P. Ui 500 V AC, Uimp 6 kV. Voltage and breaking capacities remain conditional documentation, not assigned circuit voltage.
For In up to 25 A, cage terminals accept up to 16 mm² flexible or 25 mm² rigid conductor. Connection policy does not specify permitted conductor count.

Bare breaker only: four main terminals; no accessory contacts, coil, PE, shield or communications are part of this inventory. Application-dependent main terminals are not universally required. No fixed links: protection contacts must never collapse nets, and ganging is mechanical only.

Manufacturer-authored historical catalog supplied via distributor carnevale.bz/Yumpu mirror; cover verifies Catalogo 2010–2011. Same printed pp.14–15 visually checked in supplied municipal technical-sheets.pdf, physical pp.5–6. Trip simulation, derating and coordination are outside this static circuit model.

connectionCoverage.notes: All four main terminals of the bare 24267 breaker are represented from its applicable 2P diagram. Separately fitted accessories are outside this order identity; no additional electrical interfaces are shown for the base breaker.
